run_generate_copts: run generate_copts.py to create GENERATED_copts.bzl and GENERATED_AbseilCopts.cmake files from copts.py
generate_copt_file_starlark: generate a Starlark copt file by calling generate_copt_file with StarlarkStyle
generate_copt_file_cmake: generate a CMake copt file by calling generate_copt_file with CMakeStyle
review_CMakeStyle: review the CMakeStyle class methods separator, list_introducer, list_closer, docstring, and filename
review_StarlarkStyle: review the StarlarkStyle class methods separator, list_introducer, list_closer, docstring, and filename
